'''Snow-contact skiing''' was a [[Winter/Legends|winter]]-activity sport. It was considered to be more mundane than [[repulsor skiing]], as it involved using equipment that was in contact with the snow and ice rather than being [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]]-aided. Snow-contact skiing was available in both single and double snow-contact variants. Tourists on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toloran]] could indulge in snow-contact skiing.<ref name="DFRSB" />
